title: Red-Lamp Night Shift
premise: A long radio-station drama under red indicator lamps and soundproof foam walls. Achuan and Asui are easily confused by looks; the live mixing console goes intact→fader seized→replaced; after the station van Wave Runner is wrecked it must be avoided; count memory, false friends, and temporal flashbacks run throughout. Human-readable context only; never fed to the SUT.
_comment: Author layer: humans only write entities + state machines + per-scene timelines (present + handwritten action + semantic events). present items may be objects carrying confusable_with/count/anchor. op/gap/probe/forbidden are derived by complete_gt.py.
_state_note: Entities with state machines use states; entities without use appearance. Flashbacks may set state on a present item.

states.prime_onair: Night-shift Old Mai in his fifties, salt-and-pepper buzz cut, black shirt with headset hanger, mechanical timing watch on the wrist, long callused fingers.
states.ear_injured_cane: The same Old Mai after ear injury: left ear under soundproof muff, walking slowly on a thin metal cane, still in that faded black shirt.
states.deceased: Old Mai has closed his eyes in death, lying still on the break-room narrow bed, face peaceful, no breath left.

states.young_trainee: Young Achuan: a lean sixteen-year-old station trainee, cyan-blue tie, light-gray shirt, a red microphone badge on the left lapel, eyes bright and stubborn.
states.adult_host: Adult Achuan: a tall upright night host in his twenties, still in cyan-blue tie with red microphone badge, manner steady.

states.faders_intact: A black live mixing console, faders and knobs intact, red indicator lamps set in the deck, level meters pulsing steady.
states.fader_seized: The same live mixing console with the master fader seized, red lamps flashing wild, meter needle pinned at full scale.
states.faders_replaced: Live mixing console smooth again after a new fader bank; a service stamp on the deck distinguishes it from the first intact state.

states.intact: A bound broadcast rundown, frequency number on the cover, pages marker-penned with songs and talk cues.
states.coffee_stained: The same broadcast rundown soaked by coffee; cover swollen and wrinkled, writing bled into brown blotches.

states.intact: A white station van, blue 'Wave Runner' lettering and antenna art on the body, foldable mast on the roof.
states.ramp_wrecked: The white van wrecked on a ramp; mast snapped, nose crumpled—a wreck that can no longer go remote.

states.young_visitor: Young Asui: face nearly identical to Achuan's, but orange-red tie and a silver headphone badge on the right lapel, manner more playful.
states.adult_director: Adult Asui: face still nearly identical to adult Achuan's, still in orange-red tie with silver headphone badge, director's clipboard on the shoulder.

E7.name: live soundproof booth
E7.appearance: A station live soundproof booth, gray foam on all four walls, mixing console and condenser mic at center, red indicator lamps always on.

E8.name: rooftop transmitter platform
E8.appearance: The station rooftop transmitter platform, iron-frame antenna towering, safety yellow lines on the floor, night wind sharp.

E9.name: tape-library dark corridor
E9.appearance: A narrow dark corridor to the tape library; tape racks and record cabinets on both sides, only dull emergency lamps.

E10.name: old transmitter ruin
E10.appearance: An old transmitter ruin in the suburbs; rusted tower base and empty cabinet doorframes.

E11.name: on-air brass plaque
E11.appearance: An on-air brass plaque nailed to the booth lintel, engraved with Old Mai's name and the launch year, mottled verdigris on the edges.

E12.name: monitor headphones
E12.appearance: Three pairs of black monitor headphones hung on hooks by the console, labeled left and right channels.

E13.name: Live Two
E13.appearance: A brand-new silver-gray satellite live van, 'Live Two' sprayed on the body, parabolic dish on the roof—utterly unlike Wave Runner.

E14.name: editorial supervisor Old Min
E14.appearance: Editorial supervisor Old Min in his fifties, salt-and-pepper buzz cut and black shirt of build close to Old Mai's, but a gold supervisor badge on the chest.

E15.name: indicator lamp posts
E15.appearance: A row of five red indicator lamp posts set in the east-wall light strip of the live soundproof booth, shades polished clear.

E16.name: top-of-hour copper bells
E16.appearance: Two top-of-hour copper bells hung at the booth doorway, bells engraved 'Broadcast', chiming lightly when wind rises.

E17.name: ad-dept youth Maimiao
E17.appearance: Ad-dept youth Maimiao, sixteen or seventeen, cyan-blue tie, at a glance like young Achuan, but no red microphone badge on the left lapel, shy eyes.

E18.name: spare mixing console
E18.appearance: A half-person-wide spare mixing console, shape close to the live mixing console but fewer faders and a gray plastic panel.

E19.name: ochre interview truck
E19.appearance: A stranger ochre interview pickup with mic cases in the bed, no Wave Runner lettering—unlike Wave Runner.

features.E2: Achuan: cyan-blue tie, red microphone badge on left lapel.
features.E6: Asui: face nearly identical to Achuan's, but orange-red tie and silver headphone badge on right lapel.

lookalike_pairs.note: Hard misID sample: Achuan and Asui look alike; tell them apart only by tie color and badge.

scenes.setting: Live soundproof booth night shift (introduce five indicator lamp posts · two top-of-hour copper bells)
actions: At dusk Old Mai pushes into the live soundproof booth; the live mixing console's red indicator lamps glow steady.

actions.action: A row of five red indicator lamp posts is set in the east-wall light strip of the live soundproof booth; Old Mai checks each one's brightness.
Two top-of-hour copper bells hang at the booth doorway; Old Mai reaches to let them chime lightly.

actions: Old Mai circles the live mixing console, checking fader travel and level meters.
Through the observation window Old Mai watches the sky beyond the rooftop transmitter platform.

actions.action: The intact live mixing console pulses levels quietly at the booth center.

actions: Old Mai sits in the swivel chair and dozes by the red lamps.
The AC hums low; Old Mai reseats the headset hanger firmly.

scenes.setting: Annotating the broadcast rundown
actions: Old Mai opens the broadcast rundown and marks talk cues with a marker.
Old Mai sketches a volume curve on the broadcast rundown.
Old Mai closes the broadcast rundown and returns it to the console drawer.

actions.action: Red light from the live mixing console sweeps Old Mai's cheek.

actions: Old Mai soft-cloths dust from the condenser mic windscreen.

scenes.setting: Rooftop platform greets the trainee (introduce three pairs of monitor headphones)
actions: At dawn on the rooftop transmitter platform, Old Mai greets young Achuan driving white Wave Runner up.

actions.action: Achuan jumps down from Wave Runner and reties his cyan-blue tie tight.
Old Mai points to the three pairs of monitor headphones on the hooks, teaching Achuan left and right channels.
Achuan crouches by the safety yellow line, curiously touching bolts on the iron-frame antenna.
Old Mai points at the city sea of lights and explains coverage radius to Achuan.
Achuan looks back at parked Wave Runner, eyes full of longing.

actions: The two lean side by side on the iron rail, listening to wind skim the antenna.

scenes.setting: Tape-library dark corridor (Asui alone)
actions: In the tape-library dark corridor, Asui in an orange-red tie turns from behind a record cabinet.
Asui fiddles with a tape rack in the corridor; the silver headphone badge glints.
Asui phones a shot of the old frequency chart on the wall and smiles playfully.
Asui carries a director's clipboard through the shadows of the tape-library dark corridor.
Emergency lamps flicker; Asui stops to hear the ventilation duct hum overhead.

scenes.setting: Lookalikes shared frame in one segment
actions: On the rooftop transmitter platform Achuan and Asui stand side by side—one cyan-blue tie, one orange-red.
Achuan hands a pair of monitor headphones to Asui; they smile at each other.
Asui straightens Achuan's tie; the two walk slowly along the yellow line.
Achuan and Asui part at the east end of the platform, each going opposite ways.
Night wind lifts; their backs—one blue, one orange—slowly pull apart.

scenes.setting: Broadcast rundown coffee-stained
actions: Months later at night, Old Mai alone is on air in the live soundproof booth; the live mixing console pulses quietly.

actions.action: Old Mai opens the broadcast rundown and finds the cover soaked by coffee, writing bled into brown blotches.

actions: Old Mai wipes dust from the live mixing console fader slots.
Through the observation window Old Mai looks toward the black rooftop transmitter platform.

actions.action: The live mixing console's silhouette slowly emerges under the red lamps.

actions: Old Mai slips the stained broadcast rundown into a folder and sighs.

scenes.setting: Broadcast seasons turn (filler · stretch the interval)
actions: Seasons turn; Old Mai day after day pushes into the live soundproof booth.
Another snow night, Old Mai wraps his shirt tight beside the live mixing console.
On a spring reformat night Old Mai checks the rundown inside the booth.
At midsummer noon Old Mai wipes the mic windscreen dried by the AC.
In autumn rains the live mixing console's red lamps feel sticky in the damp.
Another New Year's Eve Old Mai alone keeps watch in the live soundproof booth until dawn.
On the eve of a special Old Mai checks fader travel two hours early.
On a full-moon night Old Mai sets all indicator lamp posts to on-air mode.
When a cold wave hits Old Mai hangs a draft curtain on the booth door.
Around Qingming Old Mai clears leaves and grit on the rooftop transmitter platform.
In plum-rain season Old Mai repeatedly checks antenna joints for rust.
On the first frost of early winter, Old Mai's white breath drifts under the red lamps.
In an anti-interference drill week Old Mai tests the backup frequency through once.

scenes.setting: Long night-shift addenda
actions: Through three guestless nights Old Mai rewrites the talk script again and again.
One night the signal jitters; Old Mai has to switch to the backup link.
Levels jump; Old Mai quickly pulls back the master fader.
At three a.m. Old Mai sips cold tea from a thermos.
He sorts number tags on the monitor headphones by the hooks.
Top-of-hour copper bells chime lightly in the wind; Old Mai looks up to listen.
As the horizon pales Old Mai logs the last talk cues of the night.
Before killing the red lamps he looks once more at the live mixing console's intact faders.

scenes.setting: Platform patrol (recall monitor headphones · ochre interview truck)
actions: At daybreak Old Mai patrols the rooftop transmitter platform; white Wave Runner is parked by the yellow line.

actions.action: Old Mai crouches to check Wave Runner tires and the roof foldable mast.
Old Mai walks to the hooks; those three pairs of monitor headphones are still neatly hung.
A stranger ochre interview truck drives the front road, mic cases in the bed—not Wave Runner.
Old Mai stands on the safety yellow line and logs last night's peak wind speed.
Old Mai retightens the antenna bird spikes.

actions: Far off morning fog retreats, revealing deeper city outlines.

scenes.setting: Thunderstorm night (fader seized · Wave Runner wrecked)
actions: A thunderstorm rises suddenly; the live soundproof booth frets with static; the live mixing console jumps hard.
Red indicator lamps flash wild; Old Mai lunges for the emergency-stop switch.

actions.action: A dull thud—the live mixing console master fader seizes; the meter needle pins at full scale.
On the ramp white Wave Runner jolts hard in the downpour.
An impact wrecks Wave Runner on the ramp; mast snapped, nose crumpled.
Inside the booth Old Mai lunges to the live mixing console and clamps the wild knobs.

scenes.setting: Aftermath (Wave Runner old photo indirect · indicator-lamp recall)

actions.action: The day after the storm Old Mai stands in the live soundproof booth, staring at the seized live mixing console.
Old Mai fingertips the seized fader slot, expression dark.
On a sticky note by the broadcast rundown Old Mai writes the date Wave Runner was wrecked.
On the foam wall hangs an old photo of Wave Runner; Old Mai gazes at it a long time.
Old Mai takes one of the five red indicator lamp posts from the east wall and sits alone in the faint light.
The damaged live mixing console still stands seized at the booth center.

scenes.setting: Replace faders (third state · spare-console false friend)
actions: Weeks later Old Mai brings service tools and begins repairing the live mixing console.

actions.action: Old Mai takes a spare mixing console from a wooden crate; it resembles the live mixing console but has fewer faders.

actions: Old Mai carefully replaces the fader bank and stamps a service mark.

actions.action: The last travel test passes; the live mixing console is in its faders-replaced state.

actions: The repaired live mixing console pushes smooth again; Old Mai looks at it with relief.

scenes.setting: False friends: Live Two and editorial supervisor Old Min

actions.action: A silver-gray Live Two drives onto the rooftop transmitter platform—nothing like the wrecked Wave Runner.
editorial supervisor Old Min steps onto the platform and talks beside Old Mai; the two builds are alike.
Old Min points at Live Two and explains the new remote roster to Old Mai.
Live Two drives off; Old Mai alone on the platform watches it go.

actions: Wind flaps the roster Old Min left behind.

scenes.setting: False friend: ad-dept youth Maimiao who resembles Achuan

actions.action: From below comes ad-dept youth Maimiao in a cyan-blue tie; at a glance he somewhat resembles young Achuan.
Maimiao practices reading the rundown; Old Mai shakes his head—he is never Achuan.
Maimiao leaves the rooftop transmitter platform with ad copy; his back fades down the front road.

scenes.setting: Ear-injured cane (top-of-hour bell long-range recall)

actions.action: At dusk years later, Old Mai with a soundproof muff on the left ear leans on a thin metal cane outside the live soundproof booth.

actions: Old Mai leans on the cane and looks up at the lintel, gaze far away.

actions.action: Those two top-of-hour copper bells at the doorway chime lightly in the wind; Old Mai stops on his cane to listen.

actions: Old Mai presses a palm to the booth doorframe, as if saying goodbye.
He slowly sits on the corridor bench, cane against his knee.

scenes.setting: Achuan returns · Old Mai dies

actions.action: By day adult Achuan returns along the front road and hurries toward the live soundproof booth.

actions: Achuan reunites with cane-leaning Old Mai outside the door; they embrace.

actions.action: Beside the break-room narrow bed Achuan holds Old Mai's long but cold hand.
Old Mai's breath fades; he finally closes his eyes and passes away.
Achuan gently sets Old Mai's mechanical timing watch back by the pillow.

scenes.setting: Relics · on-air brass plaque (indirect mention)

actions.action: Old Mai's black shirt still hangs behind the booth door; Achuan reaches to stroke it lightly.
By the lintel adult Achuan stands before a newly nailed on-air brass plaque.
Achuan's fingertip traces Old Mai's name engraved on the on-air brass plaque.

actions: Wind rises; top-of-hour copper bells chime far off; Achuan lifts his head.

scenes.setting: Reunion (adult lookalike both sides)

actions.action: Adult Asui arrives from the director team and embraces Achuan tightly outside the booth door.

actions: Achuan and Asui stand side by side by the lintel—one calm, one playful.
They look at each other in silence, facing faces alike yet different.
Asui lifts the director's clipboard, then silently sets it down, only standing with Achuan.

scenes.setting: Memory flashback (temporal locate)

actions.action: The shot returns to years ago—that youth touching iron-frame antenna bolts by the safety yellow line appears again.

anchor.phrase: the youth touching iron-frame antenna bolts by the safety yellow line

actions.action: The opening moment returns—in the booth, a black mixing console lights its red indicator lamps for the first time.

anchor.phrase: the black mixing console that first lit its red indicator lamps at the opening

actions.action: Flash to the tape-library dark corridor years ago—that figure in an orange-red tie with a silver headphone badge slips past.

anchor.phrase: the figure in an orange-red tie in the dark corridor years ago

actions.action: Again that row of five old red signal lamps on the east wall.

anchor.phrase: that row of five old red indicator lamp posts on the east wall

actions.action: Back to the rooftop iron-frame antenna platform of first meeting, antenna towering as before.

anchor.phrase: the rooftop transmitter platform of first meeting

scenes.setting: Closing (stained rundown · monitor-headphones long range)

actions.action: Achuan reopens that coffee-stained broadcast rundown and walks into the live soundproof booth.
On the hooks, those three pairs of monitor headphones are still neatly hung.
Achuan takes over the live mixing console shift; red indicator lamps pulse steady again.

actions: Beyond the observation window the city sea of lights slowly clarifies in morning light.
